notes: Qemica 0.5.0 adds a full crystal and periodic-structure workflow, including CIF import, unit-cell editing, symmetry expansion, periodic bonds and safer backend compatibility checks. Analysis gains dipole vectors, Mulliken, Hirshfeld, CM5 and RESP charge views, molecular descriptors, CIP stereochemistry, clearer orbital availability and animated GIF export. Projects now support molecule search and tags, while the new guided tour, orthographic camera, graphics controls, keyboard refinements and broad visual polish make the workbench easier to learn and present. Security hardening covers custom scripts, SSH execution, migration archives, engine environments, authentication and diagnostics. Engine 0.1.5. Universal, signed and notarized macOS build. See the changelog: https://qemica-lab.com/changelog/
